mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification_outbox WHERE ORDER BY next_attempt_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', attempts = attempts + 1, claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = #{until}, version = version + 1, error_code = NULL WHERE event_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND
UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'DELIVERY_TIMEOUT', version = version + 1 WHERE event_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification_outbox WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, event_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_outbox WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND status = 'FAILED'
SELECT * FROM notification_outbox WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND event_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'READY', attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now}, claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND event_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'FAILED'
